sources.note: No `hvac` reference library exists; `roofing` was used because it carries the owl primary reference. Neither URL was Firecrawl-scraped this run — the owl template itself lives in-repo at astro-templates/owl/ and the library entry explicitly names the template directory as the structural source of truth. Tokens below are derived from astro-templates/owl/src/styles/tokens.css re-keyed to Raircon's own brand colors and fonts. Firecrawl cost for this step: $0.00.

contrast_notes: accent #bd0101 on surface #ffffff = 6.63:1 — passes AA for text and for white-on-red button fills.
accent_ink #a50000 on bg #f4f6f9 = 7.6:1 — used for eyebrows, tick marks, stars, and pins on light sections.

Brand red is too dark to sit as text on the navy dark bands (#bd0101 on #002349 = 2.37:1, fails). accent_on_dark #ff8a8a measures 7.4:1 on #002349 and is used ONLY for accent-colored TEXT inside dark panels (Testimonials eyebrow/stars/quote mark, ProcessSteps label, hero stars over the scrim). Circular icon FILLS inside those same bands keep #bd0101 with white glyphs so the brand red is what the eye reads as the button/badge color.
This split is the per-client rule the owl template's own tokens.css calls for: light background -> ink, dark panel -> a value re-derived from the client's brand.

typography.source: Both detected on the client's existing site via its Google Fonts link (Roboto: 400/500/700, Outfit: 400/500/700/800). Both are Google Fonts, so they carry over cleanly. Replaces the owl default of Montserrat + Inter.

section_styling_hints: Fixed owl section order — do not reshuffle.
Dark bands use the brand navy #002349 rather than the template's default olive, matching the client's existing header and hero treatment.
Lead with real photography of the truck fleet and technicians — the client owns genuinely good, non-stock imagery, which the roofing anti-pattern list specifically asks for.
Uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrows and uppercase button labels, as in the template.
Numbered (decimal-leading-zero) tiles in WhyChooseUs — the client already has four strong 'Why Choose Us' items with real copy.
avoid: generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats, generic hard-hat closeup)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template

CLIENT-SITE TELL: leftover boilerplate from an unrelated vertical. The current site's main body block still sells 'expert sprinkler repair services' for lawn irrigation. Every sentence in the generated site must be about Raircon's actual trades.

CLIENT-SITE TELL: sections that render empty. The current homepage has a several-hundred-pixel white void where the reviews block fails to paint. Never ship a section whose content source can be empty at build time.
CLIENT-SITE TELL: burying social proof. 4.7 stars / 219 reviews appears nowhere on the current site — surface it in the hero.
CLIENT-SITE TELL: service coverage expressed only as county map images. Use real per-city pages instead.
CLIENT-SITE TELL: stale numbers. Do not write '20+ years' or a 2024 copyright — the company was founded January 2002.
